caption: The drawing depicts a single pair of large scissors or shears, centrally positioned on the page. The scissors are shown with the handles at the top and the blades at the bottom, slightly open. Both handles are oval-shaped and appear smooth, colored in a medium brown that suggests a metallic or possibly wood texture. The blades are long, pointed, and similarly rendered in brown, with slightly darker shading along the edges and joints to provide a sense of depth and dimension. The background consists of a lightly tinted, off-white or beige rectangular area bordered by a subtle, uneven wash of a slightly darker beige color. The drawing has a realistic style, and the artist's name, "ARCHIE THOMPSON," is printed in small, uppercase letters near the lower left side of the image.
title: Bishop Hill: Scissors
